rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act
rules.requirement: All landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement must provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease. Landlords must also submit tenant contact information and a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease to the city using an online form.
rules.summary_plain: If your landlord plans to end your tenancy, they must give you a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources along with the eviction or non-renewal notice, and they must report this to the city.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si su arrendador planea terminar su contrato de arrendamiento, debe entregarle un Aviso de Derechos y Recursos para Inquilinos junto con el aviso de desalojo o no renovación, y debe informar esto a la ciudad.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all landlords planning to end a tenancy agreement in the City of Boston.
rules.penalty: First offense: warning; second and subsequent offenses: $300 per day fine.
rules.quoted_span: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires ALL LANDLORDS planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources.
